subject: gk
question:
Arrange the following RBI Governors in the correct chronological order of their tenure (from earliest to latest):

1. Dr. Y. V. Reddy

2. Dr. D. Subbarao

3. Dr. Urjit R. Patel

4. Shri Sanjay Malhotra
solution:
The correct answer is __**1, 2, 3, 4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Dr. Y. V. Reddy** served as the Governor of RBI from 6 September 2003 to 5 September 2008.
 
• **Dr. D. Subbarao** succeeded Dr. Y. V. Reddy and held office from 5 September 2008 to 4 September 2013.
 
• **Dr. Urjit R. Patel** served as the Governor of RBI from 4 September 2016 to 10 December 2018.
 
• Shri **Sanjay Malhotra** is the **Governor of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**.
 Before becoming the Governor, he was a **senior bureaucrat** and served as the **Secretary, Department of Financial Services (DFS)** in the Government of India.
 
• The chronological order of tenure based on the provided names is: 1 (Dr. Y. V. Reddy), 2 (Dr. D. Subbarao), 3 (Dr. Urjit R. Patel), 4 (Shri Sanjay Malhotra).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **RBI Governors:**

 
 
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has had several Governors since its establishment in 1935.
 
• The Governor is responsible for overseeing monetary policy, managing inflation, and ensuring financial stability in India.
 
• RBI Governors are appointed by the Government of India for a term of 3 years (renewable).
 
 
 
• **Dr. Urjit Patel:**
 
 
• He succeeded Dr. Raghuram Rajan as the Governor of RBI.
 
• Dr. Patel is known for his work on inflation targeting and the implementation of the Monetary Policy Framework Agreement.
 
 
 
• **Dr. D. Subbarao:**
 
 
• Dr. Subbarao implemented several measures to counter the effects of the global financial crisis during his tenure.
 
• He introduced steps to increase transparency in monetary policy decisions.
 
 
 
• **Important Role of RBI Governors:**
 
 
• The RBI Governor plays a critical role in influencing India's economic growth and stability.
 
• Key responsibilities include managing the country's currency, foreign exchange reserves, and banking regulations.
